# Greenstand-Overview

Machine-generated documentation for [`Greenstand/Greenstand-Overview`](https://github.com/Greenstand/Greenstand-Overview),
the org's central onboarding and overview repo for the Treetracker project: contributor guide,
nonprofit bylaws, token model whitepaper, roadmap, team directory, BDD guide, and license/code-of-conduct
docs. This is the org's overview / onboarding repo, not a code service: it has no application code.

## Start here

- **Explore:** open the [interactive viewer](https://greenstand.github.io/greenstand-documentation/Greenstand-Overview/). It has a guided tour of the repo. Then read the [onboarding guide](./ONBOARDING.md) and the [glossary](./GLOSSARY.md).
- **Source repo:** [Greenstand/Greenstand-Overview](https://github.com/Greenstand/Greenstand-Overview). Read the [README](https://github.com/Greenstand/Greenstand-Overview#readme) of the source repo before you make a change.
- **First tasks:** pick one from the [open good first issues](https://github.com/Greenstand/Greenstand-Overview/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22) of Greenstand-Overview, or from the [good first issues of all Greenstand repos](https://github.com/search?q=org%3AGreenstand+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22+is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+archived%3Afalse&type=issues&s=updated&o=desc).
- **New to Greenstand?** Read [How to contribute to Greenstand](../../docs/contribute-to-greenstand.md). It tells you how to join the community and where to get help. Everyone follows Greenstand's [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/Greenstand/Greenstand-Overview/blob/master/License%2C%20Code%20of%20Conduct%20etc/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Business domains

- **Contributor Onboarding & Development Workflow**: project onboarding, BDD feature development, GitHub fork-and-pull.
- **Governance & Legal**: nonprofit governance structure, code-of-conduct enforcement.
- **Token Economy (Greenstand Token)**: token creation & verification, token trading lifecycle (whitepaper concept).
- **Product Strategy & Planning**: roadmap planning, issue-tracking navigation.
